questions.question_text: What should you do if your car starts to skid on a wet road?
options: Brake hard immediately
Steer firmly in the direction of the skid
Take your foot off the accelerator and steer gently into the skid
Pull the handbrake up
questions.explanation: Removing power and steering into the skid helps regain control of the vehicle.

questions.question_text: What is the correct action if your vehicle begins to skid on a wet road surface?
options: Brake as hard as you can
Steer into the skid and ease off the accelerator
Steer away from the skid and accelerate
Pull the handbrake up to stop the car
questions.explanation: Steering into the direction of the skid helps regain control, while removing power allows the tires to regain grip.

questions.question_text: How does driving on an icy road affect your vehicle's handling?
options: It improves steering
It makes braking distances much shorter
It significantly reduces grip and increases stopping distances
It has no effect on braking
questions.explanation: Ice reduces friction, making it harder to steer and significantly increasing the distance needed to stop.

questions.question_text: How does driving on an icy road surface affect vehicle handling?
options: It increases tyre grip
It makes steering lighter and braking more effective
It significantly reduces tyre grip and increases stopping distances
It allows for faster acceleration
questions.explanation: Ice prevents the tires from gripping the road properly, making it much harder to control the car.

questions.question_text: How does driving on icy roads affect your vehicle's handling?
options: It improves cornering stability
It makes the steering feel lighter and reduces grip
It allows you to brake much faster
It has no impact on vehicle control
questions.explanation: Ice significantly reduces the traction between your tyres and the road, making control much more difficult.

questions.question_text: What should you do if your car begins to skid on a slippery road?
options: Brake firmly and steer hard
Take your foot off the accelerator and steer gently into the skid
Apply the handbrake
Accelerate to regain traction
questions.explanation: Avoiding harsh braking or sudden movements is key to regaining control during a skid.
